events.description:
Hi, 

My name is Ling Huang; I am an administrator at Oculii. I'm reaching out to inquire about hosting a company event at your location and would like to learn more about your available packages and pricing. 

We are interested in options that may include karaoke, mini golf, and bowling, and would appreciate if you could share:

The event package options and pricing for approximately 35 to 45 people. 
What is included in each package (duration, lane/ room reservations, staffing, etc.)
Food and beverage options
Any weekday vs. weekend pricing difference
Availability during end of June and early July, 2026.

This would be a corporate team event, and we are currently in the planning phase, so a general proposal or estimate would be very helpful for budgeting purposes. 

Thank you,
